decisions.reason: LLM choice (Melrose Labs Voice API) directly provides a list of allocated phone numbers, which better matches the subtask of gathering volunteer phone numbers than the semantic top-1 API that only lists countries.

LLM choice (Greip - /validatePhone) directly validates phone numbers with country code and phone number inputs, clearly better matching the step than the semantic top-1 API which validates TIN numbers, unrelated to phone numbers.
LLM choice is the same as semantic top-1; it does not provide phone number examples but is the best available API for country-related data.

LLM choice (D7 Verify - Get OTP Status) is for OTP status retrieval, not for compiling verification results and example numbers into a report. Semantic top-1 API is unrelated but no better alternative is provided.
